name: AutomationDirect HFWDR16C mounting-rail component
summary: HFWDR16C mounting-rail component arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: HFWDR16C is the drawing identifier for mounting-rail component in AutomationDirect's Enclosure Accessories collection. A mounting-rail component supports compatible panel devices. The rail profile, mounting method and load support must be selected for the actual equipment arrangement.

For example, in a control-panel mounting plate carrying modular devices, use the HFWDR16C reference to coordinate rail fixing points, device attachment and release access. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/Enclosure Accessories/HFWDR16C.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep rail fixing points, device attachment and release access visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named HFWDR16C drawing and its mounting-rail component role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
drawingChecklist: Match HFWDR16C, the native drawing identity and the project equipment schedule.
Coordinate fixing locations and equipment removal rather than drawing an unsupported line.
Coordinate rail fixing points, device attachment and release access with neighbouring equipment.
Confirm the current manufacturer installation instructions, selected revision and any required mounting or clearance details.
